summary: Practise ARIMA, exponential smoothing, backtesting, and scenario analysis in a five-day forecasting course. Explore the outline and enrol.
lede: Financial forecasting turns historical and current data into estimates for budgets, revenue, cash flow, and economic indicators. It is for financial analysts, economists, FP&A professionals, and planning teams who need to build, compare, and explain forecasts for planning and reporting. The course covers time-series diagnostics, baseline and ARIMA model comparison, forecast-error measures and rolling backtesting, scenario analysis, and documenting assumptions; AI-assisted anomaly screening is discussed conceptually.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who prepare, challenge, or use economic and financial forecasts in planning and reporting workflows.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of financial statements, budgeting, or economic indicators is recommended. You should be comfortable using spreadsheet formulas, charts, and tabular data. No coding or programming is required; advanced machine-learning methods are introduced conceptually.
